How do people decide to take such a risk, how do they get out of the country, and what harsh reality do they face after managing to leave Russia? We recorded several stories of successful escapes. Meduza found everyone featured in this story through the project Idite Lesom (“Get Lost”), which helped them escape. It was launched in 2022 by Grigory Sverdlin, former director of Nochlezhka, Russia’s oldest organization helping homeless people. stories.title: Artificial intelligence in L2 listening education: a comparative-critical review of ethical challenges and pedagogical opportunities
stories.description: This comparative review synthesizes 45 empirical studies published between January 2016 and March 2025 to critically examine the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into L2 listening instruction, including speech recognition tools, text-to-speech systems, intelligent tutoring platforms, chatbots, and emerging VR/AR environments. Guided by PRISMA 2020, the review uses systematic screening, dual-coder data extraction (κ = 0.88), and MMAT appraisal to strengthen methodological transparency. Findings suggest that AI-supported environments are often associated with gains in bottom-up listening processes, including phonemic discrimination, segmentation, and decoding, while also supporting learner engagement, personalized pacing, and reduced processing demands, particularly among lower-proficiency learners. Recurrent limitations include algorithmic bias, over-scaffolding, multimodal cognitive overload, data-privacy vulnerabilities, and diminished socio-pragmatic authenticity. Although several studies reported advantages of AI-enhanced environments for precision-oriented micro-skill development, teacher-mediated approaches remain important for higher-order comprehension, cultural nuance, and interactional competence. Overall, the evidence supports conceptualizing AI as a pedagogical enhancer rather than a replacement for human instruction and highlights the need for longitudinal research, culturally diverse datasets, transparent governance, and ethically grounded integration.
